summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests ivonescimab with chemotherapy and stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) in non-small cell lung cancer that has spread to the brain. Ivonescimab is given intravenously on Day 1 of cycle 1 with chemotherapy, starting at 10 mg/kg and escalating to 15 and 20 mg/kg as tolerated, and SRS (9 Gy in 3 fractions) starts on Days 7-10. The record does not state a main outcome; the first part aims to find a dose with few or mild side effects, and the second part tests whether that dose is effective.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa ivonescimab junto con quimioterapia y radiocirugía estereotáctica (SRS) en cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas que se ha extendido al cerebro. Ivonescimab se administra por vía intravenosa el Día 1 del primer ciclo, con quimioterapia, comenzando con 10 mg/kg y subiendo a 15 y 20 mg/kg según se tolere; la SRS (9 Gy en 3 fracciones) comienza entre los días 7 y 10. El registro no indica un resultado principal; la primera parte busca una dosis con efectos secundarios leves o pocos, y la segunda parte prueba si esa dosis es eficaz.
who_for: Non-small cell lung cancer, including squamous and non-squamous types, confirmed by tissue or cell testing.
At least one brain metastasis measuring 1.0 to 3.5 cm, judged safe for SRS by a radiation oncologist.
not_for: Previous immunotherapy, with limited exceptions listed in the record.
Brainstem brain metastasis 1.0 cm or larger, or leptomeningeal disease.
Another malignant tumor within 3 years before enrollment, with exceptions.
Poorly controlled blood pressure, recent significant bleeding or clotting events, or other major conditions listed.
